name: GEST (Liberty/Gladstone, MO)
note: Service covers Liberty and Gladstone; candidate also lists North Kansas City, Riverside, Parkville as unverified.

name: IRIS (Independence)
note: Dynamic-routing microtransit covering entire Independence city limits.

name: MAPS (Metro Area Public Transit System)
note: Curb-to-curb demand-response covering greater Joplin metro area across six municipalities.

name: Via Metro STL
note: Service is three named zones within St. Louis County (North County: parts of Florissant, Bellefontaine Neighbors, Hazelwood, Old Jamestown, Black Jack; West County: along I-64 from eastern Chesterfield to Town and Country near the Ballas Transit Center; South County), not the whole county and not the independent City of St. Louis. No public zone-boundary map or acreage found, so the containing county is used as an approximate proxy. Source: https://www.masstransitmag.com/alt-mobility/shared-mobility/car-sharing/press-release/21220910/bi-state-development-agency-of-the-missouri-illinois-metropolitan-district-st-louis-metro-via-metro-stl-to-expand-service-zones-may-3
